_comment: Only facts that cannot be read from Modrinth/CurseForge metadata live here: which mods replace the renderer, known conflicts, and the curated performance list. Per-version availability is always queried live, never assumed.

rendererMods.reason: These mods each replace Minecraft's chunk renderer. Only one may be installed.

conflicts.reason: OptiFine (through OptiFabric) patches the same renderer code as Sodium.
Iris and OptiFine both implement shader pipelines.
VulkanMod replaces the whole renderer; it cannot run with Sodium.
Embeddium is a fork of Sodium; install only one.
Rubidium is a fork of Sodium; install only one.
Iris requires Sodium's renderer, which VulkanMod replaces.
Canary is a Forge port of Lithium; install only one.

performanceMods.name: Sodium
performanceMods.summary: Modern chunk renderer. Typically the single biggest FPS and stutter improvement.

performanceMods.name: Lithium
performanceMods.summary: Optimises physics, mob AI and chunk ticking. Helps singleplayer worlds (the integrated server).

performanceMods.name: FerriteCore
performanceMods.summary: Reduces RAM usage, valuable on 4–8 GB machines and in modpacks.

performanceMods.name: ImmediatelyFast
performanceMods.summary: Speeds up immediate-mode rendering such as HUD, text and entities.

performanceMods.name: Entity Culling
performanceMods.summary: Skips rendering entities and block entities hidden behind walls.

performanceMods.name: Dynamic FPS
performanceMods.summary: Lowers FPS when the game is unfocused or minimised. Saves battery and heat; no effect while playing.

performanceMods.name: ModernFix
performanceMods.summary: Faster startup and lower memory in larger modded setups. Not published for every Minecraft version.

performanceMods.name: More Culling
performanceMods.summary: Additional block culling (leaves, signs, item frames). Optional.

performanceMods.name: BadOptimizations
performanceMods.summary: Caches lightmap/sky computations. Optional, small gains.

lightShaders.name: MakeUp - Ultra Fast
lightShaders.note: One of the lightest shader packs; still costs FPS on integrated graphics.
